assessments.reasoning: The complete digest-matched archive text establishes the publisher’s 1.0 heading, Roman-numbered amendments, and Netscape exhibit.

Six ranges cover the 87,898-byte SPDX detail record at the claimed commit. Its licenseId is NPL-1.0 and its licenseText contains the distinguishing amendments and exhibit. The cross-reference flag was unnecessary to establish correspondence.
The SPDX repository’s unsigned annotated v3.29.0 tag targets the same commit used to retrieve NPL-1.0.json. Its evidentiary role is limited to release attribution.

challenge.method: Tested whether SPDX had attached a Netscape label to an unamended MPL body. Checked the position and wording of amendments IV, V.2, V.3, and VI and compared the two Exhibit A notices.
challenge.results: Both texts include the contractual-obligation provision, the two-year other-products provision, alternative licensing, and the arbitration amendment. Both exhibits name Netscape Public License Version 1.0 and identify the same Original Code and Initial Developer. The abbreviated “v1.0” in SPDX’s name creates no edition ambiguity.

limitations: The shared body with MPL 1.0 cannot identify the complete license by itself. Layout and quotation marks differ between the NPL representations. The finding is limited to documentary correspondence.
reasoning: SPDX lists NPL-1.0 as “Netscape Public License v1.0.” Both representations include the Netscape 1.0 heading, §§1–12, the same sequence of Netscape amendments, and the identifying Communicator exhibit.
